intro: In this guide you will take apart the Dell Latitude 7455 laptop. You will need a Phillips screwdriver and a thin plastic pry tool, and make sure it is powered off and below 25 percent charge.
outro_disassemble: You have exposed every major component, great work.
outro_assemble: You have reassembled your laptop, well done and ready to power on.

steps.disassemble: Undo the seven Phillips-head screws around the bottom cover. Leave the two captive screws in place as you loosen them and do not force them out.
steps.assemble: Set the bottom cover back on and drive in the seven Phillips-head screws. Tighten the two captive screws at the top edge as you secure it.

steps.disassemble: Pry around the sides and front with a thin plastic tool, then release the back last and lift the bottom cover off. Use only plastic so you do not bend the cover or break the clips.
steps.assemble: Set the bottom cover back into position and press around the edges until you feel the clips snap in.

steps.disassemble: Unplug the battery connector from the main board. You must disconnect it first so you avoid a short circuit on…
steps.assemble: Plug the battery connector back into the main board until you feel it seat.

steps.disassemble: Undo the five Phillips-head screws holding the battery to the base. Keep them sorted as you work and do not puncture the battery pack.
steps.assemble: Drive in the five Phillips-head screws to secure the battery to the base as you hold it steady.

steps.disassemble: Lift the 54Wh battery out of the chassis. Do not puncture, bend,…
steps.assemble: Set the 54Wh battery back into the chassis where you lifted it…

steps.disassemble: Look at the soldered LPDDR5X memory on the board where you will see it is permanently fixed.
steps.assemble: Leave the soldered memory untouched as you move on.

steps.disassemble: Undo the single screw holding the SSD metal plate. Hold the small shield as you loosen it so it does not spring away.
steps.assemble: Hold the SSD metal plate in place and drive in the single screw as you secure it.

steps.disassemble: Pull the SSD shroud forward and lift it off to expose the thermal pad inside. Pull forward, not up, so you do not damage the M.2 slot.
steps.assemble: Set the SSD shroud back over the drive and slide it back until you lock it in place.

steps.disassemble: Locate the Wi-Fi card where you will find it close to the cooling fan.
steps.assemble: Leave the Wi-Fi card in place close to the cooling fan where you found it.

steps.disassemble: Undo the single screw and slide the Wi-Fi cover to the left to lift it off. You will then see the card underneath.
steps.assemble: Set the Wi-Fi cover back on, slide it right, and drive in the single screw to secure it as you finish.

steps.disassemble: Inspect the fan, single long heat pipe, heatsink and heat spreader you see here.
steps.assemble: Leave the fan, heat pipe, heatsink and heat spreader as you inspected them.
